text: IOS App Development Brief Overview This document outlines the development scope for We b0nd, an iOS app designed to foster meaningful connections by leveraging shared experiences, mutual bonds, and personalized recommendations. The social membership app’s ultimate goal is to reveal how closely connected we all are, allowing users to expand their social circles in a trusted way. The foundation of We b0nd’s matching system is based on shared connections, which will be one of the strongest factors in determining compatibility. By using phone contacts and mutual network visibility, the app helps users discover how they are connected to others. Our goal is to create a digital third space where bonds ﬂourish, fostering genuine relationships that resonate with members’ identities and values. Functionality ➢ User Registration and Onboarding ○ Referral-Based Access: We b0nd is a referral-only app, meaning users must receive an invitation from an existing member to join. ○ Application Process: After receiving a referral, users complete an application with a series of questions to determine their ﬁt with We b0nd’s values and community standards. ○ Register: Users sign up with an email and phone number (obligatory) ○ Onboarding: Guided setup to establish a user’s proﬁle, including an initial questionnaire to help shape their social network proﬁle. ○ Mutual Connection Setup: Uses phone contacts to identify potential connections while allowing users to exclude speciﬁc contacts, giving them control over their network’s visibility. ➢ User Authentication ○ Login: Secure login page for returning users. ➢ Home Page ○ Proﬁle as a Moodboard: Each user's proﬁle will be a moodboard that visually reﬂects their personality, featuring images, interests, and highlights to give others an instant, immersive sense of who they are. ○ Bonded Connections: Logs meaningful interactions, tracking each “bond” formed through the app. ○ Past Events: Tracks events users have attended, allowing for easy reconnection with people they met there. ➢ Feeds ○ Two Feeds: ➔ Recommended Activities and People: A feed for recommended activities and potential friends (this showcases user generated content) ➢ Daily Match: The daily matched user, ranked highly based on the matching algorithm. ➢ Daily activities: The matched activities (5 per day), ranked highly based on the matching algorithm. ➢ Daily Prompts: This feed will integrate daily prompts for users to ﬁll out, helping to reﬁne their proﬁle and improve recommendations. ● Bonding Feed: ➢ The Bonding Feed is designed to spotlight real-world connections formed through We b0nd. When two users meet up in real life as a result of a connection facilitated by the app, they’re prompted to “b0nd”— a step that conﬁrms and logs their interaction. ➢ The goal of the Bonding Feed is to foster ongoing engagement and inspire users to bond in different locations worldwide, enriching our users’ networks and driving deeper engagement within the app. ➢ This process includes a brief moment for capturing and sharing: 1. Capture the Bond with a Selﬁe: Right before ﬁnalizing the “B0nd,” users are prompted to take a selﬁe together, memorializing their meeting and adding a personal touch to their interaction. 2. Notify Shared Connections: After the selﬁe is taken and the bond is conﬁrmed, the app notiﬁes any shared connections of the newly formed bond. For example, if User A and User B meet through a mutual contact, User C, then User C will receive a notiﬁcation like, “Two of your connections are bonding right now in Los Angeles!”This dynamic creates a three-way interaction, adding a unique dimension to social networking by involving mutual connections. 3. Bonding Feed Post: The selﬁe is shared on the Bonding Feed of all three participants — the two who met and the mutual connection. This feed visibility (with the option to opt out) keeps users engaged by giving them a glimpse of their network’s interactions, while subtly encouraging them to build new bonds themselves. ➢ Adding Event or B0nd Moment ○ Add Event: A page for users to add upcoming events they are hosting or interested in. Users will upload details and location information, which will be used in the matching algorithm. ➢ Communication ○ Messaging Feed: A feature where users can message and interact with each other directly. → The UX/UI should be very strong because we want people to create these groups on the app and not leave to Whatsapp ■ Consider having a “blocked phone numbers features” so we can prevent people from sharing their phone numbers ➢ Admin Functions ○ Admin Login: Access for platform administrators. ○ User and Event Management: Tools to manage users, moderate content, and ensure the app features relevant events. ○ Member Application Review: An admin panel for easy review and approval of new member applications, allowing administrators to view completed application questionnaires and determine acceptance based on ﬁt with We B0nd’s values. Matching Algorithm One of the strongest factors in determining a match on We B0nd is the number of shared connections between users. Using phone contacts, the app helps users discover connections within their network, strengthening the quality of the match. Mutual connections will act as the social glue, providing a sense of trust and familiarity. Other factors considered will include: ➢ Activities-Based Recommendations: Tailored suggestions for activities based on shared interests. ➢ GeographicalProximity: Suggesting connections based on shared locations or proximity for in-person events or meetups ➢ Values and Interests Alignment: Incorporating user responses to speciﬁc questions about personal values, passions, and goals, helping align people with similar outlooks on life ➢ Proﬁle Moodboard: Matches are reﬁned using visual and interest-based cues in users’ proﬁles. ➢ MutualEvents or Activities:Matching users who have attended or shown interest in the same events or activities, increasing the likelihood of shared experiences. Hosting and Infrastructure Requirements To support the scope of the We b0nd iOS application, we need a reliable and cost-effective hosting solution that ensures scalability, security, and performance. Here are some requirements: ➢ Cloud Hosting: Reliable providers (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) to support growth and scalability. ➢ Database Management: Solutions like PostgreSQL or MySQL to handle proﬁles, prompts, events, and interactions. ➢ Backend Services: Using frameworks (Node.js or Django) to manage authentication, data processing, and matching. ➢ Data Security: SSL/TLS encryption, secure authentication, and compliance with privacy regulations. ➢ File Storage: Cloud storage (e.g., Amazon S3) for user-uploaded ﬁles. ➢ Monitoring and Logging: Basic tools to track app performance and troubleshoot issues. . Guidance on Matching Algorithms Additionally, we are looking for expert advice on the best matching algorithm to use. We need someone with experience in this ﬁeld who can help us decide between: ➢ Vector Search Algorithms ➢ Content-Based Filtering ➢ Gale-Shapley Algorithms used by dating apps like Hinge Additional Notes The development team is encouraged to select a technology stack that prioritizes an intuitive and premium user experience, aligning with we B0nd’s sophisticated and polished brand identity. The focus should be on building a robust and scalable iOS application that integrates seamlessly with the backend services.
